scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom published 'Why intention matters more than attention' on 13 October 2026. It introduces a distinct creative-direction signal: design for customer progress from active discovery to decision and useful real-world action, rather than optimizing only for captured attention or dwell time. Existing Q5, holiday, Beauty and visual-search guidance was also checked. Direct public-board pages returned HTTP 403 today, so no command was derived from inaccessible board content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.21.0 with 717 commands was read before modification. v2.22.0 adds exactly /intent-to-action, preserves all 717 prior commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, personal creative intelligence, settings and Firefox updater compatibility, and passed 18 regression checks. Repository bytes are verified; the version installed in the browser remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: the intention economy shifts creative success from time captured to meaningful customer progress
Scroll Mode versus Action Mode distinguishes passive consumption from purposeful solving, planning and creating
creative should bridge discovery, confidence, decision and an executable real-world or commercial next step
progress-oriented measures such as qualified saves, outbound actions, cart or lead starts and completed next steps are more useful than dwell time alone
analog aesthetic, dumb phones, nature film photography and phone-free activity searches support real-world utility but are not separate command systems
Q5 utility, holiday creative variety, Beauty specificity and visual-search readiness remain active and already represented in the catalogue
commands_added: /intent-to-action — Turn attention-led creative into an intent-led customer-progress path from discovery to decision and a useful real-world next step.
skipped: No separate /intention-economy or /design-for-exit alias because /intent-to-action captures the durable operating behavior without naming churn

No analog-aesthetic, dumb-phone, phone-free-event or nature-film-photography commands because these are topical expressions rather than reusable production systems; /analog-keepsake and existing photography controls already cover relevant styling
No changes to /performance-creative-mix because it remains focused on variant breadth and testing, while /intent-to-action has the distinct job of mapping creative to customer progress
No command was derived from public Pinterest boards that returned HTTP 403
